apiVersion: gateway.api-platform.wso2.com/v1
kind: LlmProvider
metadata:
  name: byo-guardrail-e2e-provider
spec:
  displayName: BYO Guardrail E2E Echo Provider
  version: v1.0
  template: openai
  upstream:
    url: http://host.docker.internal:{{echoLlmMockPort}}
  accessControl:
    mode: allow_all

apiVersion: gateway.api-platform.wso2.com/v1
kind: LlmProxy
metadata:
  name: byo-main
spec:
  displayName: byo-main
  version: v1.0
  context: /byo-main
  provider:
    id: byo-guardrail-e2e-provider
  policies:
    - name: byo-guardrail
      version: v0
      paths:
        - path: /chat/completions
          methods: [POST]
          params:
            endpoint: "http://host.docker.internal:{{byoMockPort}}/evaluate"
            guardrailName: TestBYOGuardrail
            auth:
              type: apiKey
              apiKeyValue: "test-secret-key"
            request:
              enabled: true
              passthroughOnError: false
              showAssessment: true
            response:
              enabled: true
              passthroughOnError: true
              showAssessment: false
  accessControl:
    mode: deny_all
    exceptions:
      - path: /chat/completions
        methods: [POST]

apiVersion: gateway.api-platform.wso2.com/v1
kind: LlmProxy
metadata:
  name: byo-custom-auth
spec:
  displayName: byo-custom-auth
  version: v1.0
  context: /byo-custom-auth
  provider:
    id: byo-guardrail-e2e-provider
  policies:
    - name: byo-guardrail
      version: v0
      paths:
        - path: /chat/completions
          methods: [POST]
          params:
            endpoint: "http://host.docker.internal:{{byoMockPort}}/evaluate"
            guardrailName: TestBYOGuardrail
            auth:
              type: apiKey
              apiKeyValue: "custom-key-value"
              headerName: "x-api-key"
              valuePrefix: ""
            request:
              enabled: true
              passthroughOnError: false
              showAssessment: true
            response:
              enabled: true
              passthroughOnError: true
              showAssessment: false
  accessControl:
    mode: deny_all
    exceptions:
      - path: /chat/completions
        methods: [POST]

apiVersion: gateway.api-platform.wso2.com/v1
kind: LlmProxy
metadata:
  name: byo-size
spec:
  displayName: byo-size
  version: v1.0
  context: /byo-size
  provider:
    id: byo-guardrail-e2e-provider
  policies:
    - name: byo-guardrail
      version: v0
      paths:
        - path: /chat/completions
          methods: [POST]
          params:
            endpoint: "http://host.docker.internal:{{byoMockPort}}/evaluate"
            guardrailName: TestBYOGuardrail
            maxResponseBytes: 10
            request:
              enabled: true
              passthroughOnError: false
              showAssessment: true
            response:
              enabled: true
              passthroughOnError: true
              showAssessment: false
  accessControl:
    mode: deny_all
    exceptions:
      - path: /chat/completions
        methods: [POST]

apiVersion: gateway.api-platform.wso2.com/v1
kind: LlmProxy
metadata:
  name: byo-timeout
spec:
  displayName: byo-timeout
  version: v1.0
  context: /byo-timeout
  provider:
    id: byo-guardrail-e2e-provider
  policies:
    - name: byo-guardrail
      version: v0
      paths:
        - path: /chat/completions
          methods: [POST]
          params:
            endpoint: "http://host.docker.internal:{{byoMockPort}}/evaluate"
            guardrailName: TestBYOGuardrail
            requestTimeout: 1
            request:
              enabled: true
              passthroughOnError: false
              showAssessment: true
            response:
              enabled: true
              passthroughOnError: true
              showAssessment: false
  accessControl:
    mode: deny_all
    exceptions:
      - path: /chat/completions
        methods: [POST]

exec: pm.test('status is 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('content matches last user message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().content).to.eql('hello there, nothing wrong here'));
pm.test('status is 422', () => pm.response.to.have.status(422));
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('type is BYO_GUARDRAIL', () => pm.expect(body.type).to.eql('BYO_GUARDRAIL'));
pm.test('direction is REQUEST', () => pm.expect(body.message.direction).to.eql('REQUEST'));
pm.test('reason is surfaced', () => pm.expect(body.message.actionReason).to.eql('content violates policy XYZ'));
pm.test('showAssessment=true includes assessments', () => pm.expect(body.message.assessments).to.have.property('category', 'toxicity'));
pm.test('status is 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

exec: pm.test('status is 422', () => pm.response.to.have.status(422));
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('direction is REQUEST (request phase caught it first)', () => pm.expect(body.message.direction).to.eql('REQUEST'));

item.name: MODIFY_ME request is rewritten before reaching upstream

exec: pm.test('status is 200 (MODIFY continues, never blocks)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

item.name: upstream echo reflects the redacted content, not the original

exec: const received = JSON.parse(pm.response.json().body);
pm.test('backend received modified content', () => pm.expect(received.messages[0].content).to.eql('[REDACTED]'));

item.name: EMPTY_MODIFY (empty modifiedContent) is treated as a protocol error, blocked

exec: pm.test('status is 422 (empty modifiedContent is not silently allowed)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(422));

item.name: 05 - Unknown verdict is fail-closed, never an implicit ALLOW

exec: pm.test('status is 422, not silently allowed', () => pm.response.to.have.status(422));

item.name: 06 - Custom auth header name and value prefix
byo-custom-auth sends x-api-key with no prefix

exec: pm.test('status is 200 (auth accepted by mock)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

item.name: mock received x-api-key with no prefix, no Authorization header

exec: const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('x-api-key carries the raw value with no prefix', () => pm.expect(body.xApiKey).to.eql('custom-key-value'));
pm.test('Authorization header was not sent for this proxy', () => pm.expect(body.authorization).to.eql(''));
pm.test('status is 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('Authorization header carries Bearer prefix + apiKey', () => pm.expect(body.authorization).to.eql('Bearer test-secret-key'));

item.name: 07 - Guardrail service oversized response or timeout

exec: pm.test('status is 422 (treated as error)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(422));
pm.test('status is 422 (timed out, treated as error)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(422));

item.name: byo-invalid-no-endpoint route never comes up (policy chain failed to build)

exec: // A policy instance that fails to build (missing/invalid required param) is
// dropped by the gateway-runtime, which logs "Failed to build policy chain
// for route, skipping" and then serves the route WITHOUT the guardrail
// (fail-open) - it does NOT take the route down. Operators must monitor that
// log line to detect a guardrail that silently stopped enforcing. This test
// pins the observable contract: the route stays reachable but the guardrail
// is provably not enforcing (a BLOCK_ME payload is NOT turned into a 422).
pm.test('misconfigured route: guardrail is not enforced (policy dropped, see runtime log)', () => {
pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 404, 500]);
if (pm.response.code === 200) {
pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include('BYO_GUARDRAIL');
